## Flora of Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound

To date, `r nrow(plant.summary)` vascular plant species have been recorded in the Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere
Region, drawing together `r format(nrow(plants), big.mark = ",")` records from historical collections, iNaturalist
observations and other sources. Each species falls into one of three groups:

<div class="howe-status-tiles"></div>

:::: {.howe-howto}
Click a group to show only the records of those species, old and recent, on the map and in the list.
Open *Filters* to narrow records by recorder, pick a plant from the list to see only its records, or use the shape
tool at the top left of the map to draw an area, double-clicking to finish. Open *Records* below the map for the
details behind each selection.
::::
